summary.text: Claire Holston is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired corporate professional, small-business owner and faith leader, and named property taxes, public education, affordable housing and healthcare among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Claire Holston said she is a longtime community member, retired corporate professional, small-business owner, faith leader, and advocate for justice and equity.
She said she has served on boards and committees and owns a business called Physically Speaking, and that her work as a spiritual practitioner and minister shaped her commitment to service.
She said she is running because of concerns she heard from Milford residents about property taxes, school funding, affordable housing, healthcare and the cost of living.

She listed economic affordability, including property taxes and housing, equitable public education, and accessible, affordable healthcare as her policy priorities, and named Moms Demand Action Gun Sense, Planned Parenthood NH Action Fund, EMILY's List and AFT-NH as endorsers.
